attempts.issue: Kubernetes test SA token expired after its eight-hour lifetime
attempts.resolution: Refreshed the same service account token without changing RBAC
Resolve MySQL and MariaDB config schema from the selected database version

attempts.issue: MariaDB ER_CHECKREAD 1020 classified as unknown, so transaction retry policy was not applied
attempts.resolution: Native MySQL driver classifies ER_CHECKREAD as serialization; retry limit and isolation unchanged
attempts.validation: passed; five workloads have zero terminal errors

attempts.issue: Catalog semi-sync recipe did not enable plugins or requested acknowledgement count
attempts.resolution: Enabled source/replica plugins and configured requested ack count; replica health waits for receiver/applier and initial schema
attempts.validation: passed on MySQL 8.4 and 8.0; live SQL plus persisted replication metrics

attempts.issue: Native load progress counted the partial batch twice
attempts.resolution: Remainder flush shares the original counter instead of copying it
attempts.validation: passed on corrected image; persisted completed load-progress records match generated and confirmed row counts

attempts.issue: mysqld --initialize ignores plugin_load_add, so strict plugin options abort fresh datadir initialization
attempts.resolution: Render loose-rpl_semi_sync_* options; readiness explicitly requires the loaded/enabled plugin and replica receiver/applier status
attempts.action: Canceled affected suite; recreate isolated test stand after cleanup
attempts.validation: passed on MySQL 8.4 and 8.0; live SQL plus persisted replication metrics

attempts.issue: Replica read_only was set only on the initdb temporary server and reset on final startup
attempts.resolution: Persist read_only=ON in the replica config and require it in the readiness query
attempts.validation: passed on MySQL 8.4 and 8.0; live SQL plus persisted replication metrics

attempts.issue: Aggregate result schema capped all segment metrics at 256 and artifacts at 64
attempts.resolution: Allow 64 x 256 aggregate metrics and 129 artifacts; retain per-segment bounds
attempts.validation: Full pipelines tests and real multi-segment result fixtures pass

attempts.issue: MariaDB 10.11 tx_isolation is a SQL variable name, not a supported startup option
attempts.resolution: Preserve the configuration input field and render transaction-isolation in the option file
attempts.validation: passed; five workloads, native telemetry, artifacts and cleanup

attempts.issue: Graphene truncated long child-run IDs to the same Kubernetes Deployment name; AlreadyExists/Ensure accepted a different run worker
attempts.resolution: Hash complete namespace and run identity; discover existing workers by exact labels; reject name collisions with a different identity
attempts.status: fixed and live parallel workers verified

verification_fixes.issue: Run-wide component metrics can exceed the Graphene 8 MiB response limit
verification_fixes.resolution: Read every exporter resource separately; preserve all returned metric series

verification_fixes.issue: New MySQL exporter names replica/source status fields differently from legacy slave/master names
verification_fixes.resolution: Preserve all mysql_slave_status fields and validate both naming families

verification_fixes.issue: A full-run mysql_up minimum includes planned shutdown during cleanup
verification_fixes.resolution: Keep full-run observations, assert DB health and replication during the workload window plus one sampling interval
